correctness.rationale: Exact Huber/soft-threshold branch differentiation yields an inactive nonnegative bound and a negative-active quadratic D_r(p) with exact maximum (1-r+r^2)/3. The maximizing p0 lies strictly inside the appropriate active branch, establishing necessity, and curvature is nonnegative elsewhere. Gamma>4 is separately obstructed at the origin. C1 patching gives convexity; the gradient-mapping identity and coercivity give the unique minimizer for gamma<4. The weighted separable identity follows by direct scalar rescaling. Symbolic identities, rational example and deterministic numerical tests execute successfully.

value.rationale: The l1-regularized logistic model is a standard sparse composite problem directly named in the motivating 2026 operator-splitting paper. Its smooth FBE geometry determines when convex-envelope methods may be analyzed as convex smooth optimization. The exact three-parameter frontier proves a non-obvious convexity-restoration phenomenon and couples it quantitatively to soft-thresholded optimizer displacement; unlike mere numerical correctness, this resolves a motivated sharp curvature question with a robust open parameter window.
